description: Land Title Settlement Department - Mampe, Kesbewa D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 521202 and others
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including detailed property descriptions, ownership details, and legal status of land titles. The content focuses entirely on land and property-related administrative matters, falling squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4).
